newsitem.title: UK: SCi Entertainment links up with John Menzies.
newsitem.headline: SCi Entertainment links up with John Menzies.

text.p: UK interactive entertainment and multimedia pubisher SCi Entertainment Group Plc said on Wendesday it had signed an exclusive UK distribution deal with John Menzies Interactive (JMI).

The deal with JMI, a joint partnership between newsagents John Menzies and multimedia distributor Funsoft, comes on top of separate agreements with Funsoft to cover European markets and GTI, a U.S. games distributor, to cover North American markets.
SCi, which was floated on London's Alternative Investment Market last month, was trading at an unchanged 161.5p per share.
Its products currently have potential access to over 28,000 retail outlets in Europe and the U.S., the company said in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4017
